03 / RESOURCE NOTES

About BacRootFit

BacRootFit brings together protein-level records associated with bacterial root or rhizosphere experiments and a curated set of reviewed background proteins. Each study is interpreted in its own experimental context.

Experimental evidence

Positive records reflect experimental perturbation evidence. Phenotypes and labels are conditional on the original organism, plant and assay.

Background records

Background proteins were screened against available annotations and known evidence. They should not be treated as experimentally proven non-colonization proteins.

Use the models

Run local prediction on your own FASTA sequences with the software and pretrained models in the GitHub repository.

Record access

This interface provides curated identifiers and source metadata. Protein sequences and external test cohorts are not distributed here.
